findings.highlight: whether Saber is complying
findings.evidenceJa: セイバーも観念してくれたのか
findings.governingReading: whether Saber has resigned herself or given in
findings.explanation: Saber’s possible capitulation to the outing becomes willing compliance, softening her guarded resistance.

findings.highlight: her expression isn’t like it is when she’s mad
findings.evidenceJa: 怒っていない顔と怒っている顔とで微妙に違っていたりする
findings.governingReading: there are subtle differences between her angry and non-angry faces
findings.explanation: Shirou’s tentative discovery that he can distinguish minute changes in Saber’s expression becomes a simple statement that she is not angry.

findings.highlight: Saber stands there dumbfounded.
findings.evidenceJa: ががーん、と立ちつくすセイバー
findings.governingReading: Saber stands frozen with a comic ga-gaan shock effect.
findings.explanation: The stylized crash of shock that makes her reaction comic disappears.

findings.highlight: The biggest stuffed animal shop in town.
findings.evidenceJa: 町で一番品揃えのいいぬいぐるみ屋
findings.governingReading: the stuffed-animal shop with the best selection in town
findings.explanation: Breadth of merchandise is changed into the physical size of the shop.

findings.highlight: But since there’re only women, there are only women and no men, it’s like an unwritten rule.
findings.evidenceJa: ただ利用客が女の子ばっかりな為
findings.governingReading: Because nearly all the customers are girls, an unspoken understanding has formed.
findings.explanation: Multiple competing phrasings remain in the sentence, repeat the same claim, and age girls into women.

findings.highlight: I would not approve of men entering this place.
findings.evidenceJa: こんなトコに足を踏み入れるヤツは男として認めない
findings.governingReading: He would not recognize any guy who set foot in a place like this as a man.
findings.explanation: The self-contradictory emasculation joke becomes ordinary disapproval of male entry.

findings.highlight: I had to laugh.
findings.evidenceJa: つい笑っちまった
findings.governingReading: He ended up laughing without meaning to.
findings.explanation: An involuntary slip becomes a claim that laughter was unavoidable or justified.

findings.highlight: How dare you laugh at other people’s preferences!?
findings.evidenceJa: 人の趣味を笑うのはよくないコトです
findings.governingReading: It is not right to laugh at someone else’s tastes.
findings.explanation: Saber’s stiff moral rebuke is intensified into a much more aggressive accusation.

findings.highlight: It’s taken about an hour to go around the store.
findings.evidenceJa: 店の最深部から入り口まで戻ってくるのに一時間弱
findings.governingReading: It takes just under an hour to return from the deepest part of the shop to the entrance.
findings.explanation: A specific return route and sub-hour duration become a vague circuit of the store lasting about an hour.

findings.highlight: I looked at Saber staring at stuffed animals
findings.evidenceJa: セイバーとぬいぐるみの睨めっこを無言で見守ったり
findings.governingReading: He silently watches over Saber’s staring contests with the stuffed animals.
findings.explanation: His sustained silent attendance and the reciprocal staring-contest joke are flattened into a casual look.

findings.highlight: felt really nervous with all the girls there
findings.evidenceJa: いったいどこからやってくるんだっていうぐらいの女の子の数に神経をすり減らしたり
findings.governingReading: The seemingly endless number of girls coming from who-knows-where wears his nerves raw.
findings.explanation: Accumulated social exhaustion and the comic sense of an inexhaustible crowd become generic nervousness.

findings.highlight: Boredom sometimes tires one’s body.
findings.evidenceJa: 気疲れっていうのは、時に足にくるものなのだ
findings.governingReading: Mental or social fatigue sometimes reaches the legs.
findings.explanation: The specific exhaustion of remaining tense in an uncomfortable social space is mistranslated as boredom.

findings.highlight: Her Saber’s words are enough to cast away my worries.
findings.evidenceJa: その言葉だけで、気苦労なんて吹っ飛んでしまった
findings.governingReading: Those words alone blow all his mental strain away.
findings.explanation: Two alternative subjects, Her and Saber’s, are both left in the visible sentence.

findings.highlight: I’m choosing places I don’t like.
findings.evidenceJa: あえて苦手なところを選んでる
findings.governingReading: He is deliberately choosing places he is uncomfortable with or poor at handling.
findings.explanation: Situational discomfort becomes personal dislike, making his sacrifice sound like rejection of Saber’s interests.

findings.highlight: Why do you continue to choose places you are unfamiliar with?
findings.evidenceJa: どうかしています、シロウ
findings.governingReading: Something is wrong with you, Shirou.
findings.explanation: Saber’s blunt judgment that his self-denying choice is abnormal disappears.

findings.highlight: today’s your day as well
findings.evidenceJa: 今日はセイバーの日な訳だし
findings.governingReading: today is Saber’s day
findings.explanation: As well implies the day belongs to someone else too, weakening Shirou’s exclusive dedication of it to Saber.

findings.highlight: I have such a cute girl with me
findings.evidenceJa: となりにこれだけ美人がいる
findings.governingReading: with a woman this beautiful beside him
findings.explanation: Shirou’s direct praise of Saber as exceptionally beautiful is shifted to cuteness.

findings.highlight: In astonishment, Saber opens her mouth as if she’s just realized that.
findings.evidenceJa: 呆然と。今更何かに気づいたように、セイバーは口を開けた
findings.governingReading: Dumbstruck, Saber parts her lips as though only now realizing something.
findings.explanation: The standalone affect becomes a dangling English fragment, and the vague object of realization is rendered with an unsupported demonstrative.

findings.highlight: You are acting the same as always, Shirou.
findings.evidenceJa: 貴方は、いつも通りの、シロウでした
findings.governingReading: You were the same Shirou you have always been.
findings.explanation: Saber’s recognition of Shirou’s continuous identity and habitual way of regarding her is narrowed to his behavior today.

findings.highlight: Saber silently follows me.
findings.evidenceJa: セイバーは黙ったまま俺に腕を引かれて
findings.governingReading: Saber remains silent as he pulls her along by the arm.
findings.explanation: The physical continuation from taking her hand to drawing her forward disappears.

findings.highlight: She murmurs to herself.
findings.evidenceJa: ぼうっとしたまま、そんなコトを呟いた
findings.governingReading: Still dazed, she murmurs those words.
findings.explanation: Saber’s lingering stunned state at the realization is omitted.
